description: Arrêts, horaires et parcours théoriques du réseau STAN | GTFS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole du Grand Nancy. List of stops, timetables and routes of all buses and trams on the [STAN] network ( operating on the territory of the [Grand-Nancy Metropolis] ( Transport on Demand (TAD) is not included. Coverage: Métropole du Grand Nancy. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical stops, schedules and routes of the STAN network | GTFS" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole du Grand Nancy. Its keywords include stan, gtfs, nancy, metropole, transport, grand-nancy. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GTFS. The listing shows 2026-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
